overview: The Medford Liquor License Commission met to approve several one-day licenses, change of locations, and license amendments, and held a disciplinary hearing regarding allegations of serving alcohol to a minor.

items.title: Approval of June Minutes
items.summary: The Commission deferred approval of the June meeting minutes to the next monthly meeting.

items.title: One-Day License: Harvester Energy Festival
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for the city's annual Harvester Energy Festival on October 17, 2026.

items.title: One-Day License: Medford Chamber of Commerce
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for the Chamber of Commerce's annual Oktoberfest to be held on October 3, 2026, with a rain date of October 4, 2026.

items.title: One-Day License: Simple Fare LLC
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for Simple Fare LLC to host a grand reopening event on October 2, 2026.

items.title: One-Day License: Mary Queen of Peace Parish
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a young adults singles mixer on September 19, 2026, contingent upon receipt of their liability insurance policy.

items.title: One-Day Licenses: Medford Public Library
items.summary: Approved two separate one-day licenses for the Medford Public Library for events on October 4, 2026, and November 7, 2026.

items.title: One-Day Licenses: POTS Collaborative
items.summary: Approved four separate one-day licenses for POTS Collaborative events scheduled on October 1, 16, 30, and 31, 2026.

items.title: License Amendment: Medford's Cappy's Inc.
items.summary: Approved a change of location application for Medford's Cappy's Inc. from 10 Riviera Beach Parkway to 50 Station Landing.

items.title: License Amendment: Medford Brewing Company
items.summary: Approved amendments for an alteration of premises and a change of license type to allow the serving of beer, cider, and distilled products.

items.title: Disciplinary Hearing: Great American Beer Hall
items.summary: The Commission took under advisement allegations regarding the service and consumption of alcohol by a 19-year-old minor on June 24, 2026.
